Feirongda.why: Makes server and data-center thermal products - single-/two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, 3D VC heat sinks, CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and racks, TIM - with AI-server cooling demand and orders rising, so AI-server build-out drives its thermal-management growth.
Feirongda.evidence: Feirongda half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-22-2026): AI-server cooling demand grew fast and order volume kept rising; its server / data-center cooling products include TIM materials, heat sinks, fans, 3D VC heat sinks, single-/two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, flow controllers, CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and liquid-cooled racks, and many product types are delivered in volume.

players.product: AI-server single- and two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, 3D VC heat sinks, 8kW / 140kW / 600kW CDUs, quick connectors, liquid-cooled chassis and racks, TIM thermal materials and fans

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 results (annual report): revenue RMB 6,526,685,748.76, up 24.74% YoY; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 364,560,225.57, up 59.97%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 316,432,095.42, up 60.89%; operating cash flow RMB 437,005,614.59, up 10.72%; gross margin 19.47% (down 0.82 points). Quarterly revenue: Q1 RMB 1,181,287,129.43, Q2 RMB 1,701,861,466.24, Q3 RMB 1,734,140,242.21, Q4 RMB 1,909,396,910.88; quarterly net profit: Q1 RMB 57,763,731.39, Q2 RMB 108,325,180.50, Q3 RMB 120,082,705.66, Q4 RMB 78,388,608.02.

Segments and volumes (annual report, FY2025): thermal management materials and devices RMB 2,466,926,221.32, 37.80% of revenue, up 32.34%, gross margin 13.81% (down 4.39 points); EMI shielding materials and devices RMB 1,768,884,670.36, up 17.31%, gross margin 30.79%; lightweight and other functional devices RMB 1,693,137,720.86, up 23.59%; base-station antennas and related devices RMB 373,156,657.95, up 20.71%. Domestic sales RMB 5,301,141,840.33 (up 28.89%); overseas sales RMB 1,225,543,908.43 (up 9.51%, gross margin 30.25%). Sales volume 7,629,747,682.29 PCS (up 21.40%); output 7,179,629,070.82 PCS (up 12.90%).

quarterly_data.signal: Top five customers (annual report) were 50.41% of 2025 sales (RMB 3,289,881,871.47); the largest 19.99%, then 16.93%, 6.22%, 3.86% and 3.41%; names not disclosed; 0.00% of sales from related parties among them. Top five suppliers were 15.72% of 2025 purchases (largest 5.51%), names not disclosed.

Servers and telecom (annual report): the company says it has entered the supply chains of mainstream server makers at home and abroad and has reached supply cooperation with mainstream domestic server makers, with some products delivered in volume; its server, switch and data-center cooling products include TIM materials, heat sinks, fans, 3D VC heat sinks, single-phase and two-phase liquid-cooling cold-plate modules, flow controllers and CDUs. It describes itself as a qualified supplier of mainstream domestic and overseas communication-equipment makers (base-station radomes, RRU/BBU cooling assemblies). Besides the data-center / server customers named in later filings, the annual report's list also named Fiberhome Supermicro, Compal and ASUS.

Liquid-cooling R&D projects (annual report, FY2025): 8KW rack-mounted air-liquid CDU - prototype designed, in performance testing and reliability validation (target PUE<=1.3); 140kW rack-mounted liquid-liquid CDU - system architecture done, in project construction design (target PUE<=1.2); 600KW cabinet liquid-cooling CDU for ultra-high-density AI clusters - in system architecture design (target PUE<=1.2). The company says the 8kW / 140kW / 600kW CDU line is meant to become a core incremental business. A 6U 3DVC heat sink for 1000W-plus environments met sample performance (Qmax>1200W); the AI-server 3DVC module project was closed, with typical products in scaled engineering application on high-performance servers. FY2025 R&D spending RMB 350,965,688.44, 5.38% of revenue; 1,315 R&D staff.

2026 plan (annual report; the company states it is not a performance commitment): keep raising R&D, focusing on high-thermal-conductivity graphene pads, high-thermal-conductivity energy-storage films, solderable conductive gaskets, high-heat-flux liquid cold plates and embodied-AI robot cooling; extend from materials and components to core modules and whole-system contract manufacturing; build out Vietnam and Thailand overseas supply-chain support with localized capacity; and, building on global key customers, focus on expanding high-value-added businesses such as AI liquid-cooled racks, NEV supercharging EMS and pump-driven liquid cooling.

Capacity (annual report): the raised-fund 'New energy related devices construction project' was topped out in September 2025; 2026 focuses on fit-out and equipment installation, with use expected at the end of 2026, supporting energy storage and NEV and consolidating South China capacity. The company plans to invest no more than RMB 3 hundred million of own funds in the 'Feirongda smart manufacturing and R&D center project' in Shapingba District, Chongqing, with construction planned to start in August 2026 and completion and use expected by the end of August 2028, filling its southwest China capacity gap.
